Assume the fluid density is 1000 kg/m³.
Use the kinematic viscosity ν = μ/ρ = 0.01 Pa·s / 1000 kg/m³ = 1 × 10⁻⁵ m²/s.
Use the inner cylinder radius R_in = 0.05 m, the gap d = 0.002 m, and the angular speed Ω = 100 rpm = 10.472 rad/s.
Use the standard narrow-gap Taylor number definition Ta = Ω² R_in d³ / ν².
Substitute the values to get Ta = (10.472² × 0.05 × 0.002³) / (1 × 10⁻⁵)².
The Taylor number is approximately 439.
